title: polystichum squarrosum var. chinense
intro: Polystichum squarrosum var. chinense, commonly known as Chinese Rock Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and aiding in the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Rock Fern include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiparasitic properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
